settings.heading: Inside our formulas
settings.text: The actives that power Elysium products.

settings.name: PDRN
settings.text: Polydeoxyribonucleotide — DNA fragments studied in skin science for their role in supporting the skin's natural recovery processes.

settings.name: Exosomes
settings.text: Tiny extracellular vesicles used in advanced cosmetic formulas focused on skin renewal and a revitalised look.

settings.name: NAD+
settings.text: A coenzyme involved in cellular energy, explored in skincare for its role in keeping skin looking healthy and resilient.

settings.name: Mandelic acid
settings.text: A larger-molecule alpha hydroxy acid from bitter almonds, known as a gentler exfoliant for smoother-looking skin.

settings.name: Glycolic acid
settings.text: The smallest alpha hydroxy acid, used to exfoliate the surface for a brighter, more even-looking complexion.

settings.name: Vitamin C
settings.text: An antioxidant widely used to help brighten the look of skin and support protection against environmental stressors.
